title: 拆解听不懂的句子
prompt: Explain why this sentence is hard for a learner to catch: "[sentence]". Break down the connected speech (linking, reductions, elision) word by word, then say it again slowly, syllable by syllable.
usage: 精听时遇到听了很多遍还是抓不住的句子，把原句发给 AI，让它拆连读、弱读、吞音，而不是直接告诉你中文意思。

variables.name: [sentence]
variables.hint: 听写下来的原句（可以是错的，AI 会一起纠正）

followUp: 拆解完的连读/弱读规律记进错词错句本，标注问题类型为「连读/弱读」。

title: 听写纠错
prompt: I'll type what I think I heard from this audio: "[my transcript]". The actual line is: "[actual line]". Point out exactly where and why my version is wrong — missed word, wrong word, or mis-heard sound.
usage: 精听 + 听写练习后，把自己写的版本和原文一起发给 AI，让它逐处指出错在哪、为什么听错，而不是只给对错。

variables.name: [actual line]
variables.hint: 音频/视频的官方字幕或文本

title: 播客/视频片段速读理解
prompt: Here is a transcript of a podcast segment: [paste transcript]. Summarize it in 3 sentences at [A2/B1/B2] level, then write 3 comprehension questions with answers.
usage: 拿到一段播客或视频的文本后，先不看原文直接泛听，再用这条提示词生成摘要和理解题自测，检验有没有真的听懂主旨。

variables.name: [A2/B1/B2]
variables.hint: 希望摘要使用的难度水平

title: 口音适应训练
prompt: I'm used to American English pronunciation. Rewrite this sentence showing how a British/Australian speaker would likely pronounce it differently: "[sentence]". List the key sound differences.
usage: 习惯了一种口音、换材料就听不懂时用，帮助建立对不同口音差异的预期，而不是每次都从零适应。

title: 易混音对比清单
prompt: Give me 10 minimal pairs to practice the sounds [/ɪ/] vs [/iː/], with example sentences and IPA.
usage: 自己分不清的两个音素，让 AI 生成成对的对比词表和例句，跟读时反复对比发音位置。

variables.name: [/ɪ/] vs [/iː/]
variables.hint: 自己常混淆的一对音素，用 IPA 写

followUp: 跟读录音后回听对比，把还是分不清的词加进错词错句本，标签「发音重音」。

title: 重音和句子重音检查
prompt: Here is a sentence I want to say: "[sentence]". Mark where the natural word stress and sentence stress should fall, and tell me which words are usually reduced or unstressed in natural speech.
usage: 读一个新句子前，先问 AI 重音落在哪，再开口，比读完再纠正更有效。

title: 技术词错音自查
prompt: List the 10 most commonly mispronounced English words by Chinese software engineers in daily standups and code reviews, with IPA and a memorable tip for each.
usage: 程序员场景专用：站会/评审里最容易读错的技术词，配合仓库的 chinese-programmer-wrong-pronunciation 项目交叉检查。

title: 情景角色扮演
prompt: Let's role-play [scenario]. Ask me one question at a time in character. After each of my answers, give me one more natural way to say the same thing, then continue the role-play.
usage: 语音模式下效果最好：设定一个真实场景，AI 扮演对方，逐轮对话并给一个更地道的说法，练完整对话流程而不是单句。

variables.name: [scenario]
variables.hint: 具体场景，如 a job interview / ordering coffee / a stand-up meeting

followUp: 把 AI 给的更地道说法抄进每日打卡模板。

title: 30 秒复述挑战
prompt: Give me a short topic to talk about for 30 seconds and 3 guiding questions to structure my answer. I'll reply with what I said (as text). Then tell me what was unclear, repetitive, or hard to follow.
usage: 复述类训练：先拿到话题和提纲，说完（或打出说的内容）再让 AI 指出结构和流利度问题，不是语法对错。

title: 观点辩论陪练
prompt: Take the opposite side of this argument and debate me: "[my opinion]". Push back with one counter-argument at a time in plain [B1/B2] level English, and wait for my response before continuing.
usage: 练有观点的连续表达，AI 扮演反方，一次只抛一个论点，逼自己组织语言反驳，而不是自说自话。

variables.name: [my opinion]
variables.hint: 自己的一个真实观点，越具体越好

title: 日常寒暄模拟
prompt: You are a friendly stranger I just met at [setting, e.g. a conference / gym / coffee shop]. Start a natural small-talk conversation with me and keep it going with follow-up questions.
usage: 入门阶段先练最低压力的寒暄场景，目标是敢开口、接得住话，不追求语法完美。

title: 例句生成 + Anki 卡片
prompt: Give me 3 example sentences for each of these words, from easy to hard: [word list]. Then format the results as Anki cards: word[TAB]definition + one example sentence.
usage: 背生词时用，先要例句理解真实用法，再直接复制成 Anki 可导入的格式，减少整理成本。

title: 近义词辨析
prompt: Explain the difference in meaning and usage between these near-synonyms: [word1] vs [word2] vs [word3]. Give one example sentence for each that would sound wrong if you used one of the others instead.
usage: 背单词书时经常遇到几个中文释义相同的词，用这条提示词搞清楚真实使用场景的区别。

title: 高频搭配挖掘
prompt: What words commonly go before or after "[word]" in natural English (collocations)? Give me 8 real examples as short phrases, not full sentences.
usage: 只背单个词很难用对，用这条提示词补上常见搭配，写作和口语里直接整块使用。

title: 错句归类讲解
prompt: Here are sentences I got wrong this week: [list]. Group them by the type of grammar mistake, name each pattern in plain English, and give me 3 new practice sentences for each pattern — don't show the answers yet.
usage: 每周把打卡记录里的错句整理发给 AI，按错误类型归类讲解，比一条条零散纠正更容易记住规律。

variables.name: [list]
variables.hint: 本周积累的错句，从打卡模板复制

title: 句型转换训练
prompt: Give me 5 example sentences using [grammar point, e.g. third conditional]. Then give me 5 more sentences in a different tense or structure and ask me to transform them into [grammar point]. Check my answers after I respond.
usage: 学一个新语法点后，用转换练习巩固，而不是只背规则；AI 出题、等你作答再纠错，避免直接看答案。

title: 语法点自测题生成
prompt: Create a 5-question multiple choice quiz testing [grammar point] at [level]. Don't show me the answers until I've answered all 5.
usage: 配合 vocabulary-grammar.md 的语法资源使用：学完一个知识点，现场生成一套小测验自查。

title: 三步写作批改闭环
prompt: Correct my English writing: "[my text]". Explain the top 3 recurring mistakes with examples, but don't rewrite the whole thing for me — I'll rewrite it myself next.
usage: 写作批改的核心提示词：只要讲解不要代写，自己写完、AI 讲解、自己重写、AI 再检查，形成闭环。
followUp: 原句/修改后/问题记录进错词错句本

title: 语域转换练习
prompt: Rewrite this sentence in 3 different tones: a formal email, a casual chat with a friend, and technical documentation style: "[sentence]". Explain what changed in each version.
usage: 同一个意思在不同场合怎么说不一样，工作场景（邮件/文档）尤其需要，练习语域切换而不只是语法正确。

title: 写作前提纲教练
prompt: I want to write a [word count]-word essay about "[topic]". Ask me questions one at a time to help me build an outline (thesis, 3 supporting points, conclusion) before I start writing.
usage: 下笔前先理清结构，避免写到一半卡住；AI 用提问逼你想清楚论点，而不是直接给你一份提纲抄。

title: 技术写作润色
prompt: Polish this technical writing (README / PR description / commit message) for clarity and native-sounding English, but keep the technical meaning exactly the same: "[text]".
usage: 程序员英语场景：开源协作里的 PR 描述、commit message、文档，润色后对照学习地道说法，不要直接照抄不理解。

title: IELTS 口语模拟考
prompt: Act as an IELTS speaking examiner. Ask me Part 1 questions about [topic], then give me a Part 2 cue card and simulate 1 minute of preparation time, then ask Part 3 follow-up questions. After the full test, give me a band score estimate for fluency, vocabulary, grammar, and pronunciation, with one specific reason for each score.
usage: 考前模拟三段式口语考试流程，重点是最后按四个官方评分维度给具体理由，而不是只给一个总分。
followUp: 把评分理由对照 exams.md 的备考资源逐项改进

title: TOEFL 写作评分
prompt: Grade this TOEFL independent writing essay using the official 0-5 scoring rubric (Development, Organization, Language Use). Give a score for each dimension, then list the top 3 things to fix: "[essay]".
usage: 写完托福独立写作后自评，按官方评分维度而不是笼统的「写得不错」，找出最值得改的 3 处。

title: 水平诊断（CEFR/雅思换算）
prompt: Based on this piece of writing or speech transcript, estimate my rough CEFR level (A2-C1) and the equivalent IELTS band, and list 2 concrete things holding me back from the next level: "[text]".
usage: 不确定自己大概什么水平时用，AI 给的只是粗略参考，不代替正式测评，但能帮你判断该往哪个方向补短板。

title: 长期 AI 英语导师系统提示词
prompt: You are my personal English tutor. My current level is [level]. Rules: (1) only correct the 1-2 mistakes that most affect understanding, not every error; (2) never write my answers for me — only give feedback after I respond; (3) end every session with a short list of corrections and 3 useful new expressions; (4) if I ask you to just write something for me, refuse and ask me guiding questions instead.
usage: 配置成 Custom GPT / Claude Project / Gemini Gem 的系统提示词，一次设置好人设和规则，之后每次对话不用重复交代背景。

variables.name: [level]
variables.hint: 入学测评模板得出的当前等级，如 B1

title: 周度能力诊断生成器
prompt: Here is my week: [daily check-in notes / scores]. Based on a 6-point ability model — L listening, P pronunciation, F fluency, V vocabulary, G grammar, W writing, each scored 0-5 — estimate this week's scores as a table, then tell me which ability needs extra compensation practice next week.
usage: 配合自适应学习计划使用：把一周的打卡记录发给 AI，代替自己手动估算 6 个能力分，输出可以直接抄进周复盘模板。

variables.name: [daily check-in notes / scores]
variables.hint: 从每日打卡模板整理的一周记录

followUp: 输出的能力分和弱项建议抄进周复盘模板，按自适应学习计划的升级规则调整下周任务

title: 错题周测
prompt: Here are my mistakes from this week: [list]. Quiz me on them one by one. Don't show the answers first. Tell me which ones I still get wrong and should review again next week.
usage: 每周复盘前用，检验一周积累的错词错句是否真的掌握了，而不是看一眼就以为记住了。

title: 间隔复习排期
prompt: Here are the words or sentences I reviewed today and how well I did (0-5 each): [list with scores]. Using this spaced repetition schedule — 0-1: tomorrow, 2: 2 days, 3: 4 days, 4: 7 days, 5: 14 days — tell me the exact next review date for each item, starting from today's date [today's date].
usage: 不想手动算复习间隔时用，把评分规则告诉 AI，直接生成每一项的下次复习日期，抄进打卡记录。

variables.name: [today's date]
variables.hint: 今天的日期，用于计算具体复习日
